name: Crystalline Collection
summary: Felflick asks you to gather crystals growing from fel blood pools, where ashes from Archimonde have fallen. Their unusual formation makes them useful for draining fel energies.

sections.title: Crystals in the Pools
sections.body: Behind Felflick, fel blood pools bear crystals formed where Archimonde's ashes have fallen. You gather several kinds for him because their formation gives them a knack for draining fel energies, a problem for Felflick that may still leave the crystals useful.

sections.title: A Pristine Find
sections.body: When you bring the crystals back, most are slimy from the grime. Felflick searches through them until he finds one with an even color and a faint glow. He is pleased to have a crystal in pristine condition, and says it will do nicely.

faq.answer: Felflick asks you to gather crystals from the fel blood pools behind him.
The crystals grow from fel blood pools on the side of the hill where Archimonde's ashes have fallen.
Their unusual formation makes them especially good at draining fel energies.

faq.q: Why does Felflick want different kinds?
faq.answer: Felflick asks for a few kinds, saying he will know what he needs when he sees them.
